question: Which authorities are cited to support the teaching on liberation at death?
premises: The Ratnamala scripture contains a relevant teaching.
Another authoritative scripture and lord are also cited.
inference: Therefore the teaching on liberation at death is supported by multiple scriptural authorities.
uncertainties: The identity of Ahīśāna in this citation is not fully explicit from the verse alone.
plain_english: This was said by the Supreme Lord in the holy Ratnamala scripture, and also by Ahīśāna, bearer of the burden of supporting the world, in his own scripture.
